The presence of actinic keratoses is more common in older individuals, aligning with the patient's age. DF (Dermatofibroma) typically presents as a firm, non-tender nodule, which does not seem to be the case here. VASC (vascular lesion) is ruled out due to the lack of typical vascular features. agent conservative fusion: evidence was not strong enough to override the baseline diagnosis, so the baseline label was preserved.

DF (Dermatofibroma) typically presents as a firm, non-tender nodule, which does not seem to be the case here. VASC (vascular lesion) is ruled out due to the lack of typical vascular features.
baseline_qwen.follow_up_considerations: Given the clinical presentation and the patient's age, it is important to monitor the lesion closely.
